name: paxos-fix-suite-1
cmd: set -euo pipefail; cp -a frozen-paxos/. .; root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/lane-i-fix-check.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$root"' EXIT; bun regression-driver/paxos-fix-source.ts "$root"; cd "$root"; bun install --frozen-lockfile; bun scripts/test-shards.ts --shard 1/7; echo PAXOS_FIX_VALIDATION_PASS shard-1
